rows.note: All three header tiers reorder: host sections persist in the UI prefs, repo headers only under repo+manual grouping, and project-group drops report a tabOrder the shell applies and re-sorts; anchor correction stays suppressed across commit frames.
One commitWorktreeDropAtPoint resolves pointer, native and document releases (section/nest/board/reorder/abandon) with shared anchors.
Imported cards emit pinned-fallback placement and ambiguous hostContext labels; covered by the parity test.
The inbox keeps its repo section even when Pinned single-location removes natural items; both policies are tested.
Per-repo pending/error/forceVisible state; success claimed only after the authoritative refresh resolves, rejection paints the row error.
The painted row pipeline selects only the PR/hosted-review caches its grouping and card properties need.
Focus-list, navigate up/down, editable-field guards (except .xterm-helper-textarea) and container key handling are covered.
Reveal expands lineage ancestors, keeps the request pending while the target exists, clears when it vanishes, and starts inline rename after mount.
Pending reveals resolve by host-qualified identity and use sidebarWorkspaceStillExists to choose keep-pending vs clear.
Pending rows carry creationId, Keep-hidden is gated to repo-group placement, and virtual rows expose absolute frame attrs.
Headers carry sticky tiers, status/Pinned variants, drop-target attrs, repo icon/fork and path/scan indicators, and ignore nested toggle events.
The composed row model derives workspaceLineageByChildKey from the app's rich and path lineage, so a folder row inherits its parent PR; no-lineage rows stay unchanged.
Folder-backed repo surface/indent uses the ported indentation constants for both worktree and folder rows.

Descendants fold into the parent card slot (one virtual row), collapse hides the subtree, keyboard/activedescendant/reveal resolve a folded child, and children expose lineage depth/last-child markers with the inline geometry.
Floating insertion lines exist for repo headers, project-group headers and the host section tier (z-40); the group line is reachable now that the group writer exists.
The group + disables for confirmed-stale and ambiguous-connection paths with reason-specific tooltip copy.
Repo/group/folder rows and headers are filtered by the same host scope as Cmd+1–9, folder rows honor other-device exclusion (forced targets excepted), and catalog host stamps reach the pipeline.
The painted list is the computed visible id order (same pipeline as Cmd+1–9), fed by one live-agent snapshot per render epoch; the agent-send target is forced visible on both paths.
Change Project Icon opens an inline emoji/clear picker that writes repoIcon through a validated catalog mutation, refreshes the catalog, and disables remote projects (their icon lives on the host).
Projects filter panel with repo badge, SSH badge, search/empty/highlight reset, keydown containment, repo-id filtering.
Four Orca group-by modes incl. project-group; pressed semantics and persisted normalization.
rAF focus with cleanup, query reset on reopen, alternating placeholder.
Hide other-client workspaces toggle with hydration gate and persisted visibility.
Worktree activation publishes a reveal request consumed by the single displayOptions writer.
Trigger badge and empty-state gate share sidebarHasActiveFilters including host/device flags.
Reset filters executes the computed clear plan through the single writer.
worktreePassesSidebarFilters predicate used by the batch pipeline, host-qualified; collapse/order stays out.
Attention timestamps scan done/blocked/waiting history and feed the painted sort.

Sleep eligibility, real webview/guest destruction, terminal teardown, durable sleep intent/wake and 50ms delay are wired; Hydra has no ephemeral VM, so the suspend contract persists via workspace_sleep_state.
Ordered pipeline: webviews destroyed before terminals (keepIdentifiers), durable suspend state written/restored, active-row clearance and re-activation guard; no VM runtime to suspend.
Parallel pipeline groups by host+repo, orders deepest-first, serializes turns, cancels ancestors, and consumes preserved_branches from the delete outcome for the consolidated toast.
Lineage persists through the new worktree_lineage table + get/set commands; the anchored picker applies/removes parents for all selected workspaces, and the menu disables the action while deleting.

Delete decision tree validates the confirmed instance, offers the primary-checkout confirmation, resolves SSH ghost/disconnected hosts with real reconnect/forget commands, and forces descendant confirmation.

Within-group reorders replay through buildManualOrderUpdatesForVisibleGroups; a status-lane release resolves its slot and, only in manual sort mode (or same-lane), commits through buildManualOrderUpdatesForGroupDrop; other modes write status only.
